titles.title: Genetically Engineered Crop and Animal Farmer Protection Act
titles.titleType: Short Titles as Introduced for portions of this bill

titles.title: To provide additional protections for farmers and ranchers that may be harmed economically by genetically engineered seeds, plants, or animals, to ensure fairness for farmers and ranchers in their dealings with biotech companies that sell genetically engineered seeds, plants, or animals, to assign liability for injury caused by genetically engineered organisms, and for other purposes.
